services.name: Kayak, Paddleboard, Canoe Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy all the St. Lawrence River has to offer on your choice of kayaks or canoes. We are located in the protected waters of French Creek Bay so kayak paddling is easy, and we are close to the village of Clayton, NY, and a short paddle to several beautiful islands in the 1000 Islands. You can also explore up to 7 miles of the French Creek Wildlife preserve in the Thousand Islands where you will see a variety of types of wildlife (luckily, we are located a very short paddle from this unique wilderness reserve and experience.) services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: We offer a variety of motorboats for rent to explore and enjoy your time in the 1000 Islands, Lake Ontario & the St. Lawrence River at our Clayton, NY Marina. We have powerboats - bow riders, pontoon boats, cabin cruisers and fishing boats. All motorboats include the necessary life jackets and safety equipment. blurb: Bayside Marina is located on the St. Lawrence River in Clayton, NY, offering seasonal and transient dockage with fresh water and electricity. They provide power boat rentals, kayak, paddle board, and canoe rentals, as well as boat repairs and indoor/outdoor storage. Dockage includes access to a second marina at Lake Ontario Mariners’ Marina in Henderson Harbor for the same price.
